answer: Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. By the pulse of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, the cheapest attack must cost more than honest work. The pearl is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the jetty. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
